name: Among the Faithful

angles.text: As a priest, you follow familiar holy or shadow faiths. At Falaath Village, the cultists follow Skypriests devoted to Al'Akir the Windlord and channel the storm's primal strength.
As a shaman, you know the elemental forces the cult of Al'Akir worships and commands through its mastery of storm energies.

aliases: who are the faithful of alakir
faq.answer: The Faithful of Al'Akir are a cult devoted to the Windlord, Al'Akir. They are based around Falaath Village in the Shen'dar Highlands, wield storm magic, and answer to Lorthuna.
faq.q: Who are the Faithful of Al'Akir?

faq.answer: Skypriest Aanders is a ranking officer of the cult at Falaath Village. He assesses and inducts new recruits, though he is occupied at the village inn receiving an important guest during your infiltration.
Lorthuna is the supreme leader of the cult of Al'Akir. Her covert presence at the Falaath Village inn reveals that the cult is arranging an imminent, high-level offensive in the highlands.

The cult plans simultaneous strikes on Shen'dar Village and the western watchtower. The village is an understandable target, but the watchtower's purpose in the attack remains a mystery to highland defenders.
faq.q: Why is the cult targeting the western watchtower?

faq.answer: Falaath Village lies in the Shen'dar Highlands. It is a major base and staging ground for the Faithful of Al'Akir and their new recruits.

aliases: what are the cults goals in shendar highlands
faq.answer: The cult seeks to expand its influence and unleash storm magic across the Shen'dar Highlands. Under Lorthuna's leadership, its immediate assault targets Shen'dar Village and the western watchtower.
faq.q: What are the cult's intentions in the Shen'dar Highlands?

sections.body: You enter Falaath Village in the Shen'dar Highlands as an eager recruit among the Faithful of Al'Akir. The cultists boast that their ranks are growing. They claim their devotion gives the storm its shape and fury. New arrivals are usually sent to Skypriest Aanders for scrutiny, but an unexpected meeting at the village inn interrupts that routine.
sections.title: Infiltrating Falaath Village

sections.body: Skypriest Aanders hosts a distinguished guest on the north side of town. While he is occupied, you can move through the settlement without his watch. Eavesdropping on the leaders reveals their immediate plan: a coordinated military push across the Shen'dar Highlands.
sections.title: The Secret Guest

sections.body: Lorthuna is the mysterious guest at the inn and the supreme commander of the entire cult. Her presence points to an aggressive strike against Shen'dar Village and the western watchtower. Shen'dar Village is a clear population center. Yet local scouts cannot understand why the remote lookout tower is a target or what lies behind the cult's storm-driven offensive.
sections.title: Lorthuna's Scheme

summary: At Falaath Village, you pass among the Faithful of Al'Akir in the Shen'dar Highlands. Their growing ranks and storm magic draw close scrutiny, while their leaders gather with plans that threaten nearby settlements and outposts.
attribution: In-game quest text: Among the Faithful
